mapper.select: SELECT t.tent_id::text AS "id",t.opp_id AS "opportunityId",p.proj_id AS "projectId",p.proj_nm AS "projectName", t.dev_id AS "developerId",d.dev_nm AS "developerName",n.job_cd AS "jobCode", greatest(p.ctrt_bgn_dt,to_date(t.bgn_ym||'01','YYYYMMDD')) AS "startDate",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate", n.mon_mm AS "contractMm",CASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd IN ('MO','DP') THEN pr.mon_uprc ELSE NULL END AS "billingUnitPrice" FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=t.opp_id JOIN tb_sl_opp_need n ON n.opp_id=t.opp_id AND n.need_sn=t.need_sn JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=o.proj_id JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=t.dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mon_uprc FROM tb_hr_dev_prc WHERE dev_id=t.dev_id AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON true WHERE t.tent_stat_cd='CNVT' ORDER BY t.tent_id

SELECT dev_id AS "id",dev_nm AS "name",job_cd AS "jobCode",grade_cd AS "gradeCode",emp_type_cd AS "employeeType", use_yn AS "useYn",drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",jncmp_dt AS "joinDate",retire_dt AS "retireDate" FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE emp_type_cd IN ('FT','CT','FL','OS') ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT t.tent_id::text AS "id",t.opp_id AS "opportunityId",t.need_sn::int AS "needSn",t.dev_id AS "developerId", t.bgn_ym AS "startMonth",t.tent_stat_cd AS "status",t.src_scrn_id AS "sourceScreenId",t.proc_dttm AS "processedAt", to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym||'01','YYYYMMDD')+(n.prd_mcnt::int-1)*interval '1 month','YYYYMM') AS "endMonth",o.win_prbl_rt AS "probability" FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=t.opp_id JOIN tb_sl_opp_need n ON n.opp_id=t.opp_id AND n.need_sn=t.need_sn WHERE t.tent_stat_cd='ACT' AND o.opp_stat_cd='ING' ORDER BY t.tent_id
